title: Man And Bear Sanctuary: Bosnian electrician’s rescue reshapes family home; future of bears uncertain
summary_full: In 2019, electrician Petar Tubic stumbled upon a deserted bear cub named Masa in the woods. Over time, he nurtured Masa, eventually establishing a sanctuary for rescued animals, which now includes an additional bear, Ljubica. However, Tubic is troubled by their strong human bonds, raising concern over the bears' future. The sanctuary has transformed into a community attraction and draws attention to the complexities involved in wildlife rescue.
